newsitem.title: ITALY: S&P affirms IMI ratings, longterm outlook stable.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms IMI ratings, longterm outlook stable.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poors said on Tuesday it affirmed its 'AA-/A-1+' counterparty rating for Italian medium to long term credit institute, Istituto Mobiliare Italiano SpA.
S&P said in a statement it was also revising its outlook on IMI's long-term rating to stable from negative.

"IMI's ratings reflect the group's superior asset quality, strong capitalisation, satisfactory and stable profitability, as well as its strong franchise in a variety of services in Italy," the S&P statement said.
The credit agency said that unlike most of its domestic competitors, IMI's asset quality remained high during the recent downturn in the Italian economy.
"The outlook is based on the stabilisation expected in IMI's financial situation now that the bank has completed its internal reorganisation," S&P said.
"Although the operating environment is increasingly competitive, IMI's strong franchise in its main lines of business should enable the bank to maintain its stable performance," the statement added.
IMI is due to report first half results later on Wednesday. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
